title: an import that cannot be read, or holds no one, is refused and nothing is recorded
line: a file whose header says ANSEL, a character set not read here, is refused saying so; a file whose header says UTF-8 but whose bytes are Windows-1252 is refused naming the byte; a file with a header and no person is refused saying it holds none; each leaves no import and no artifact behind, so the same file can be ingested once it is right

steps.say: the harness file with its header's CHAR changed to ANSEL
the harness file written in Windows-1252 and still saying UTF-8
the harness file cut to its header and submitter, no person
the same file once it is right, as the owner would re-export it
